brief.goal: Warehouse Management System. Build an end-to-end WMS for managing warehouse operations, from receiving inbound goods through putaway, storage, inventory control, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and operational reporting.
brief.problem: Manual or fragmented warehouse processes lead to errors, delays, and lack of visibility across receiving, putaway, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and inventory control.
brief.purpose: Support the full warehouse lifecycle: receiving, putaway, storage, inventory control, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and operational reporting.

requirements.statement: Receiving clerks register inbound goods and create goods receipts with line details.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Goods receipt created with item, quantity, batch, and warehouse
Receipt lines linked to purchase order or ASN

requirements.statement: Putaway operators assign received items to storage locations using putaway rules (priority and free space).

acceptance_criteria.statement: Putaway rule applied per item and warehouse
Notification when no warehouse has free space

requirements.statement: Picking operators pick items from assigned locations per pick list and confirm picked quantities.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Pick list created from sales order
Picked quantity recorded per line
Pick list submitted when complete

requirements.statement: Packers pack picked items into containers, print packing slips, and verify contents.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Packing slip created from submitted pick list
Packed quantities recorded per line
Packing slip printed with container details

requirements.statement: Shipping staff create shipments from packing slips, assign carriers, and generate shipping documents.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Shipment created with carrier and tracking number
Shipping documents generated
Delivery note submitted on shipment

requirements.statement: Inventory controllers run cycle counts, record counted quantities, and approve stock adjustments for variances.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Cycle count created with items and locations
Counted quantity vs system quantity compared
Variance posted to difference account on approval

requirements.statement: System automatically creates replenishment requests when pick location stock falls below minimum.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Replenishment request created when projected stock <= reorder level
Request routed to putaway operator for execution

requirements.statement: Warehouse supervisor monitors operations via dashboards and resolves exceptions (space shortages, pick shortages, count variances).

acceptance_criteria.statement: Dashboard shows open receipts, pick lists, shipments, exceptions
Supervisor can reassign or escalate exceptions

requirements.statement: Returns are received, inspected, and processed as sales returns against original delivery notes.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Return received against delivery note
Sales return recorded
Stock restored to available or quarantine

requirements.statement: Operational reports show receiving efficiency, putaway accuracy, pick/pack/ship rates, inventory accuracy, and exception trends.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Report: receipts per day, lines per hour
Report: putaway accuracy %
Report: pick/pack/ship throughput
Report: cycle count variance trends

requirements.statement: When automatic reordering is enabled and an item's projected stock falls to its reorder level, a purchase material request is created for the item's reorder quantity, marked as auto-created, and the purchase manager is alerted; an item whose projected stock is above the reorder level is left out.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each item can have a reorder level and a reorder quantity, also per warehouse.
One request is created for each item below its reorder level.

requirements.statement: When automatic creation of a request fails, the purchase manager is told the error.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The error message reaches the purchase manager.

requirements.statement: Physical stock is counted periodically and at year end; the counted quantity and the valuation rate are entered per item and warehouse, starting from the quantity and rate the system shows.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each count line names an item and warehouse.
The system's current quantity and valuation rate are shown.

requirements.statement: A submitted stock reconciliation overwrites the book quantity with the counted quantity; the value difference is posted to a difference account that defaults to stock adjustment, and the result can be checked in the stock ledger.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The difference account is confirmed before submission.
The updated balance appears in the stock ledger.

requirements.statement: Stock is moved between warehouses with a material transfer stock entry, which deducts it from the source warehouse and adds it to the target warehouse; submitted entries can only be changed by cancelling and amending them.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A transfer names a source and a target warehouse.

requirements.statement: Every stock movement is recorded in the stock ledger, so a count can be checked against the updated balance.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The updated balance can be checked in the stock ledger.

requirements.statement: A transfer through a transit warehouse is recorded in two entries: goods in transit, then the end of transit at the target warehouse; the transfer status is not started, in transit or completed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The transfer shows its status.

requirements.statement: Incoming goods are registered on a receipt.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A receipt lists the items and quantities received.

requirements.statement: Each received item is assigned to a warehouse by putaway rules: one rule per item and warehouse, with a priority (1 is highest) and a capacity; a warehouse is filled up to its capacity, then the next eligible warehouse is used; when no warehouse has free space the user is notified.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The received quantity is split across warehouses by priority and free space.
The user is notified when there is no free space.

requirements.statement: A pick list records which items to take from which warehouse to fulfil a sales order that is not yet fully picked; warehouses are chosen first-in-first-out and, for batched items, the batch closest to expiry; it is saved for the picker and submitted when picking is complete.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A pick list shows the warehouse for every item.
A pick list is submitted after picking with the picked quantities.

requirements.statement: A delivery note is created from a submitted pick list when a shipment leaves the warehouse; on submission stock is updated with a stock ledger entry per item; its status shows draft, to bill, completed, return issued, cancelled or closed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A delivery note can only be created after the pick list is submitted.
Submitting a delivery note updates stock.

requirements.statement: An order can be delivered in parts on several delivery notes, for example half one week and half the next; a delivery note can be closed short so that unsent quantities are neither sent nor billed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Pending quantity on the order is updated by each delivery note.

requirements.statement: Every stock movement is recorded as a stock ledger entry when a document is submitted, so balances can be traced.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each submitted delivery or return has a stock ledger entry per item.

requirements.statement: Items returned by a customer are recorded as a sales return against the delivery; when all items are returned the delivery note shows return issued.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A return updates stock.

Handle exceptions when no warehouse space is available

roles.name: Putaway operator
responsibilities: Assign received items to storage locations using putaway rules
Confirm putaway completion and update location assignments
Resolve putaway conflicts and space constraints

roles.name: Picking operator
responsibilities: Pick items from assigned locations per pick list and confirm quantities
Handle batch and serial number tracking during picking
Report picking discrepancies and location issues

rules.description: A purchase request is created only when the item's projected quantity is not above its reorder level.

source.reference: https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/auto-creation-of-material-request (Projected quantity above the reorder level leaves the item out of the request)

rules.description: A counted quantity equal to the quantity in the system needs no adjustment; any difference is posted to the difference account.

source.reference: https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/stock-reconciliation (Quantity is overwritten with the counted figure; difference account defaults to Stock Adjustment)

rules.description: Automatic creation of the request either succeeds or fails and is reported to the purchase manager.

source.reference: https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/auto-creation-of-material-request (If auto creation fails, the Purchase Manager is told the error message)

rules.description: A transfer goes directly to the target warehouse or through a transit warehouse recorded in two entries.

source.reference: https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/stock-entry (Transit: two entries, the second created with End Transit)

rules.description: A received quantity is placed in warehouses by priority and free space; if no warehouse has free space the user is notified.

source.reference: https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/putaway-rule (Capacity, priority, and notification when no warehouse has free space)

rules.description: A delivery is complete when the delivered quantity reaches the ordered quantity, otherwise the rest is delivered on another delivery note.

source.reference: https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/delivery-note (Partial Deliveries: of 10 items, deliver 5 one week and 5 the next on two delivery notes)

rules.description: A packing slip is created only from a submitted pick list with picked quantities.

source.reference: Confirmed by warehouse supervisor in design review

rules.condition: Pick list status = Submitted AND picked quantity > 0

rules.description: Packed quantity must match picked quantity within tolerance; otherwise packing quantity mismatch exception is raised.

source.reference: Confirmed by packer lead in design review

rules.description: A shipment is created only from a verified packing slip with all containers verified.

source.reference: Confirmed by warehouse supervisor in design review

rules.condition: Packing slip status = Verified AND all containers verified = true

rules.description: Carrier assignment requires an available carrier; if none, carrier assignment failed exception is raised.

source.reference: Confirmed by shipping staff lead in design review

rules.condition: Carrier available = false OR carrier system unreachable

rules.description: Automatic replenishment request is created when pick location projected stock falls to or below reorder level.

source.reference: Confirmed by inventory controller in design review

rules.condition: Projected quantity <= Reorder level AND location type = Pick

rules.description: Cycle count difference within threshold is auto-approved; difference exceeding threshold requires supervisor approval.

source.reference: Confirmed by inventory controller in design review

source.reference: Stated in the Design Studio conversation; confirm with the business owner

rules.condition: Disposition IN (Restock, Repair, Scrap, Vendor Return)

exceptions.name: Automatic request failed
exceptions.trigger: Creating the material request automatically fails, for example because no fiscal year exists for the date.
exceptions.recovery: The purchase manager is told the error message.

exceptions.name: No free warehouse space
exceptions.trigger: No warehouse has free space for the received quantity.

exceptions.name: Partial delivery
exceptions.trigger: Less than the ordered quantity was delivered.
exceptions.recovery: The rest is picked and delivered on another delivery note; the order's pending quantity is updated.

exceptions.name: Cycle count difference exceeds threshold
exceptions.trigger: Counted quantity differs from system quantity beyond allowed variance
exceptions.recovery: Supervisor reviews and approves adjustment or initiates investigation

exceptions.name: Packing quantity mismatch
exceptions.trigger: Packed quantity differs from picked quantity beyond tolerance
exceptions.recovery: Packer adjusts quantities or escalates to supervisor

exceptions.name: Carrier assignment failed
exceptions.trigger: No carrier available or carrier system unreachable
exceptions.recovery: Shipping staff retries or selects alternative carrier

terms.definition: The stock level at which a purchase request is created for an item.
A count of physical stock that corrects the quantity in the system.
A rule that assigns received items to a warehouse by priority and capacity.
A list of the items to take from stock to fulfil an order.
